title: Gemini catalog review
description: Review pending hotspots, foods, and merchants first, then find 100 new candidates. Inspect each decision, its evidence, and missing checks before applying it.
reviewDescription: Gemini checks the current pending catalog and records evidence and decisions. A completed review can still leave items awaiting verification.
discoveryDescription: New candidates are saved as pending and inactive, then reviewed. Finding a candidate does not approve or publish it.
reviewFirst: Complete a review of pending items before starting discovery.
callLimits: Daily limit: {daily} calls; this run: up to {run} calls.
notConfigured: Gemini is not configured. Complete service setup first.
reviewComplete: This source review is complete. Items that do not meet publishing requirements remain pending.
assessmentDescription: A Gemini recommendation does not grant publishing permission. Approval remains unavailable when exact map identity, durable coordinates, or other required verification is missing.
waitForRun: This run is queued or running. You can inspect evidence now; select and apply results after it stops.
selectPage: Select eligible items on this page ({count})
invalidEvidenceLink: The source URL cannot be opened safely
noGapsReported: No gaps reported; server approval checks still apply.
noItems: No review items on this page yet.
confirmDescription: Check the items and reasons below. The server rechecks versions and required verification when submitted; ineligible items are skipped.
reconnecting: Connection interrupted. Reconnecting to retrieve progress.
unknownItemError: This assessment is incomplete, and no identifiable reason was recorded. No decision has been applied. Check the service status before retrying.

errors.catalog_run_in_progress: A catalog review is already active. Check its progress or resume unfinished work first.
errors.gemini_not_configured: Gemini is not configured. Set its API key in the admin settings first.
errors.catalog_response_truncated: The Gemini response was truncated. This assessment is incomplete.
errors.catalog_response_blocked: Gemini safety checks blocked the response. No usable assessment was returned.
errors.catalog_response_empty: Gemini returned no usable assessment content.
errors.catalog_response_invalid: The Gemini response does not match the required assessment format.
errors.catalog_response_ids_invalid: The item identifiers in the Gemini response do not match this candidate batch.
errors.catalog_provider_rate_limited: Gemini is temporarily limiting requests. Try again later.
errors.catalog_provider_timeout: The Gemini response timed out. This assessment is incomplete.
errors.catalog_provider_unavailable: Gemini is temporarily unavailable. This assessment is incomplete.
errors.catalog_review_provider_circuit_open: Repeated provider errors safely stopped this run. Progress is saved; check the service settings before resuming.
errors.catalog_review_daily_budget: Today's Gemini safety call budget is exhausted. Progress is saved.
errors.catalog_review_call_limit: This run reached its call limit. Progress is saved, but the same run cannot be resumed.
errors.catalog_review_incomplete: Some assessments are incomplete, or not enough new candidates were found.
errors.catalog_review_failed: The review did not finish. Progress is saved. Check the service status.
errors.catalog_queue_unavailable: The run is saved but could not be queued. Resume it later.
errors.catalog_review_unconfigured: A Gemini API key is not configured, so assessment is unavailable.
errors.catalog_review_budget_exhausted: Today's Gemini safety call budget is exhausted. Progress is saved.

gaps.missing_five_locale_content: Names or descriptions are missing in one or more of the five languages
gaps.missing_destination: A valid destination link is missing
gaps.missing_meal_type: Meal types have not been set
gaps.missing_wikidata_identity: A Wikidata item identity is missing
gaps.missing_exact_map_identity: Exact map identity is missing (Naver in Korea; Google Place ID elsewhere)
gaps.map_not_independently_verified: The exact map identity has not been independently verified
gaps.missing_durable_coordinates: Coordinates backed by a durable source are missing
gaps.missing_direct_merchant_source: A merchant website or listing that directly supports the shop name is missing
gaps.missing_food_category: A food category has not been linked
gaps.missing_verified_source_evidence: Verifiable quotations from checked sources are missing
gaps.low_assessment_confidence: Gemini assessment confidence is too low; human review is needed

applyReasons.action_not_allowed: The selected action is not currently allowed for this item
applyReasons.assessment_expired: The assessment has expired. Review this item again
applyReasons.candidate_no_longer_pending: The candidate no longer exists or is no longer pending
applyReasons.candidate_changed: The candidate changed after assessment. Review it again
applyReasons.publication_requirements_missing: Required publishing checks are still missing; approval is unavailable
